title: Learning Optimal Search Strategies
summary: We explore the question of how to learn an optimal search strategy within the example of a parking problem where parking opportunities arrive according to an unknown inhomogeneous Poisson process. The optimal policy is a threshold-type stopping rule characterized by an indifference position. We propose an algorithm that learns this threshold by estimating the integrated jump intensity rather than the intensity function itself.
